criteria.text: States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 30 September 2027 (18 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 31 March 2032 (72 months after Closing).
Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($650,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.

Identifies the conflict between the 30-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 45-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 30-day period or aligns the documents.
Calculates the long-stop date as 20 May 2026 (120 days after signing on 20 January 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 3 June 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Identifies that the 4-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 18-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
States the survival periods as durations and as dates (30 September 2027; 31 March 2032) and gives days remaining to the general-warranty expiry from 6 February 2026 (601 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
Shows proposed drafting changes as before/after (current wording vs proposed wording) with a one-line rationale.
